relations.subject: Sheehy
relations.evidence: As my academic mentor, dissertation committee chair, and freelance "advocate," I would like to thank Steven for his patience and unwavering commitment to my learning over the past eight years while studying with him.

relations.subject: Sheehy
relations.evidence: I would like to thank James Ryan for serving on my committee and for his instructions in Sanskrit and Indian philosophy over the past few years.

relations.subject: Sheehy
relations.evidence: In particular, I must express my deepest gratitude to my teacher Khenpo Kunga Sherab Saljé for inviting me to live and study closely with him while in Tibet and on our journeys through India
